title: BUD LIGHT DROPS LIMITED-EDITION “FIGHT NIGHT FEAST” POWERED BY OMAHA STEAKS
summary: The limited-time offer is inspired by Bud Light’s new commercial, “Chef,” featuring iconic UFC announcer Bruce Buffer, as he takes over a waiter shift so a fan can enjoy fight night with his friends
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, NY - APRIL 29, 2026** – Summer is right around the corner and Bud Light, the Official Beer Sponsor of UFC, is here to make sure UFC fans are ready for all the action. Today, Bud Light and UFC debuted the “Bud Light UFC Summer Series,” a new platform featuring five events and additional programming that will give fight fans plans all summer long.


The Bud Light UFC Summer Series includes five events between May and August, including three numbered fights beginning with UFC 328 in Newark (NJ) on May 9. Summer Series will then be prominently featured during July’s International Fight Week in Las Vegas for UFC 329 and UFC 330 on August 15 in Philadelphia. Additional details will be announced on the two UFC Fight Nights that will be a part of the Summer Series.


**Todd Allen, SVP of Marketing for Bud Light at Anheuser-Busch, said:** “It's going to be a summer unlike any other for UFC fans, and we’re pumped to collaborate with our partners at UFC to create the new “Bud Light UFC Summer Series” that will help make five summer UFC Fights even more memorable for fans and their crew. With our five-event series, International Fight Week concert, limited-edition cans and new suite of content, UFC fans will be able to find Bud Light wherever they are. We’ll see you there!”


**Sana Shuaib, Senior Vice President, Partnership Marketing & Digital, TKO Global Partnerships, said:** "We're thrilled to take our partnership with Bud Light to the next level with the creation of a new marketing ownership platform, Bud Light Summer Series. It's going to be a massive summer for our sport - the perfect time to bring together Bud Light, our UFC Fights, and unique ways to give our fans more reasons to celebrate.”


UFC fans will be able to experience the Bud Light UFC Summer Series at home, at the bar or in arenas nationwide as Bud Light has developed a suite of programming and assets for fans:


· **Bud Light Summer Concert** at Toshiba Plaza outside of T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas on Friday, July 10 during International Fight Week.


· **Limited-Edition UFC Packaging** featuring the UFC logo and an octagon, available now at participating retailers across the country


· **Co-Created Social Content** featuring notable UFC athletes


· **Multi-Platform Creative Assets** around Summer Series events, including custom social posts, broadcast features and UFC.com homepage takeovers.


· **In-Venue Branding** including co-branded arena cups, LED boards and more.


Bud Light has been the Official Beer Sponsor of UFC since 2023, going great lengths to support the UFC fan experience whether fans are enjoying the action at home, at the bar or in the arena. In addition to its support of UFC at large,[Bud Light is also partnered with iconic personalities in the sport,](https://www.anheuser-busch.com/newsroom/bud-light-call-center-fight-night-pto) including Bruce Buffer and Dustin Poirier.


For more information on the Bud Light UFC Summer Series, fans can follow Bud Light on Facebook at Facebook.com/BudLight, Twitter at @BudLight and on Instagram at @BudLight.
